title: Intercession of the Spirit
definition: The intercession of the Spirit is His work of helping believers pray in weakness according to the will of God.
summary: The Spirit intercedes for believers when they do not know how to pray.
christFocus: Jesus intercedes for His people at the Father's right hand, and the Spirit helps them pray from within.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The Spirit's intercession is a deep comfort for weak believers. When they do not know what to pray, the Spirit helps them in ways deeper than their own understanding.

This ministry does not make prayer unnecessary. It encourages prayer by assuring believers that God meets them in weakness.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: People often feel that weak prayers are useless. This doctrine matters because God helps His people even when their words are inadequate.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Pray honestly even when you feel weak or wordless. Trust that the Spirit helps and that God knows your need perfectly.
